Package Piece

package Piece
  • Class
    Description
    Bishop
    Represents a Bishop chess piece with movement logic restricted to diagonals.
    King
    Represents a King chess piece with movement logic restricted to 1 chess board tile omnidirectional.
    Knight
    Represents a Knight chess piece with movement logic in an "L" shape directed on the chess board.
    Pawn
    Represents a Pawn chess piece with movement logic with 2 squares (on initial move) or 1 square forward on the chess board.
    Piece
    Represents an abstract chess piece, providing shared functionality for all specific piece types.
    PieceColor
    Represents the two possible colors of a chess piece: white or black.
    Queen
    Represents a Queen chess piece with movement logic that can travel any number of tiles omnidirectional on chess board.
    Rook
    Represents a Rook chess piece with movement logic restricted to move vertically or horizontally.
